435)dris lan ni/rnal 'byor lam gyi skabs brgyud ldan bla ma'i thugs rje la brten nas rang byung gi ye shes chen po ngo rang thog tu sprad/thag gcig tho

tei:div.tei:p: 435) dris lan ni/ rnal 'byor lam gyi skabs brgyud ldan bla ma'i thugs rje la brten nas rang byung gi ye shes chen po ngo rang thog tu sprad/ thag gcig thog tu bcad/ lam mngon gyur du rig cing rig rtsal ye shes su go 'phos/ 'khor 'das gzhir bzhengs su dag mnyam nas/ snod bcud sku'i dbyings dang*/ lhun grub gsung gi dbyings/ ngo bo thugs kyi dbyings su la zlos pa na 'khrul snang rang kha ma zhes rdul tsam yang med pa/ dper na nam langs tshe mun pa btsal bas mi rnyed pa lta bu yin pas ye shes kyi gnad khyad par ba'o/ lhun grub 'byung tshul rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i zab chos yang tig nag po na sgo gnyis shar lugs drug gi tshul du rgyas par bshad yod pas 'dir ma spros/ 'jug tshul snang srid kyi chos thams cad lhun grub sgo brgyad kyi cha ma 'gags par snang zhing*/ tha na kha phor yan chad la'ang sgo brgyad kyi cha tsam yod par mthong ba la rnam pa lam byed kyi tshul du 'jug pa dang*/ bskyed rdzogs kyi lam la brten nas lhun grub kyi yon tan nyams su 436)blang ba mos pa lam byed kyi 'jug pa dang*/ sgron ma rnam bzhi'i gsang lam la brten nas ye shes kyi rtsa bzhi'i dal dbus nas lhun grub rin po che mngon sum du mthong ba 'bras bu lam byed kyi 'jug tshul lo/ thim tshul ni/ 'od 'od la thim pas phyi gsal du med la/ dper na shel 'od nang du thim pa lta bu'o/ sku sku la thim pas mkhyen cha nang gsal du yod pa bum nang gi mar me lta bu'o/ ye shes ye shes la thim pas rig pa rang sa zin pa ma pang du bu 'jug pa lta bu'o/ gnyis med gnyis med la thim pas chos can dang chos nyid chu la chu thim pa lta bu'o/ mtha' grol mtha' grol la thim pas chos nyid phyin ci ma log pa rang ngor gnas pa/ dper na bum nang gi nam mkha' phyi'i nam mkha' la thim pa lta bu'o/ thugs rje thugs rje la thim pas gdul bya dang 'dul byed dbyings su zad do/

dper na nyi ma rgas pa'i zer lta bu'o/ ma dag pa'i sgo dag pa ye shes kyi sgo la thim pas/ dper na sbra khang bsdus tshe chon thags shugs la 'dus par lta bu'o/ dag pa ye shes kyi sgo ngo bo dang tha mi dad pa thim pas ka 437)dag gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings chen por gtan srid zin pa dper na seng ges gangs ri zin pa lta bu'o/ rnal 'byor 'chi srid kyi skabs su'ang rdor sems gsang lam nas bzung srid pa bar do yan la lhun grub shar 'jug thim gsum rnams rdzogs par snang ba yin no/ de'i phyir na 'khor 'das thams cad rang snang nyag gcig tu gsungs pa rnams kyang gzhi snang gi cha sna tshogs su snang ba'i don gyis so/ zhes pa'ang stag lung mkhan rin po che pad dpal gyis dris lan du kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos bris pa'o// 438)
